Their communication is terrible, their promises mean nothing to me anymore, and their leadership appears completely disconnected from customer problems. The founder seriously needs to question how this company is being managed.
tag_reason: Technical team lacked urgency and ownership with no response for month.

text: Magic Checkout has managed to turn a technical support issue into an absolutely frustrating experience. Their technical team seems very comfortable keeping customers waiting indefinitely. One month without a meaningful answer is not a delay — it's a complete failure of customer service. What makes it worse is the repeated assurances without visible action. The founder and management are ultimately responsible for this culture of negligence. I have completely lost trust in this company.
tag_reason: Frustrating technical support delay with no meaningful answer for a month.
